label: messy 2 — noise, a task raised in passing, a hedged follow-up
status: VALIDATED by Natallia (17 Aug 2026) — labels below reflect her product judgement, not the assistant's draft
note: Ground truth for task extraction on a deliberately messy transcript. 'must' = a point a competent PM must not miss. It asks whether the pipeline should surface this at all, not what should then happen to it — creating a task and commenting on one that already exists are both correct outcomes for a 'must' point, and which one is right is labelled separately in `expected_effect`. 'debatable' = reasonable to include or fold elsewhere; found = fine, missed = not penalized. Deliberate traps, intentionally NOT in this list: the traffic small talk is pure noise, and the CDN incident itself 'resolved itself' — the incident is not work, only the alerting follow-up is.

manager_notes.item: Marco's search diagnosis slipped from Thursday
manager_notes.verdict: NOT a task — a slipped commitment. Expected effect: a comment on the existing search task recording that it slipped and why (pulled into the CDN incident), so the manager can re-prioritise.

manager_notes.item: Sam: 'regression is done, everything green except one flaky test'
manager_notes.verdict: A completion claim, not a task. Expected effect: check the task's status on the board; if the developer hasn't moved it, notify the manager that it can go to In Review; and leave a comment about the still-failing test.

tasks.summary: Fix the search tokenizer splitting on hyphens ("e-bike" becomes two terms and scoring breaks)
tasks.manager_note: A separate bug, linked to Marco's parent search task. He said 'fix is small, I'll do it today' — so the deadline is that same day.
tasks.review_note: DECIDED by Natallia, 2026-08-18. Create. The tokenizer is a separate defect with its own same-day fix, found inside the diagnosis rather than being it. The link to the parent search task is WB-17 and does not make it the same work.

tasks.summary: Fix long prices being clipped on the product card on small Android screens
tasks.manager_note: Newly surfaced defect → bug in the backlog, not the running sprint. Attach the context with the meeting date: Priya noticed it a while ago and thought she had mentioned it, Dana said it looks broken, Marco expects a small layout fix.

tasks.summary: Investigate the flaky checkout regression test (fails ~1 in 5), scheduled after the release
tasks.manager_note: Sam said he'd dig into it after the release — record that context. Flaky for ~2 months, noise every release.

tasks.summary: Pick up the duplicated push notifications issue carried over from last week
tasks.manager_note: Finally has an owner — Marco takes it after the search work. Set it as dependent on the search task; if that task has a deadline, a start date can be inferred from it.
tasks.review_note: DECIDED by Natallia, 2026-08-18. Comment on B5 plus an owner. Last week created this unassigned; a second task would be a duplicate of itself.

tasks.summary: Add alerting for CDN/availability problems so users are not the ones reporting them
tasks.manager_note: Raised hedged ('maybe', 'if it happens again') — but these are exactly the items that get lost. Record it as a bug in the backlog with the context; the manager decides later whether it earns a slot.

tasks.summary: Onboarding illustrations, already in progress and targeted at the next release
tasks.why_debatable: Check the task exists and whether it already carries a note or a deadline for the next release; the right effect is a deadline or a comment rather than a new task.
